messages:
maya: FYI opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8540 to update model-cards for NebulaX-8k and Polaris-lite. Changes: rename max_sequence -> max_context_tokens, clarify sequence limit, add bench rows, add SDK v2 snippets (py/js), and compatibility notes for q4 variants.

sam: Skimmed. Please make sure bench rows specify seq_len and batch_size. Also the NebulaX card lists max_context_tokens=8192 but bench was run at 4096  we should avoid confusing readers.

diego: Note for compatibility: NebulaX q4_0 can fallback to CPU kernels on older AVX nodes; add a "CPU fallback" column or short caveat with link to /runtime/quantization#cpu-fallback. Otherwise customers will expect identical latency.

maya: Will add the caveat and a small compatibility matrix column. Also updating the bench table to include seq_len=4096 row and separate columns for bs=1/4/8 with p50/p95.

anya: SDK v2 snippets ready. Python streaming example:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=REDWOOD_KEY)

# SDK v2 streaming
async for chunk in client.stream_generate(model="nebulax-8k", input="Summarize..."):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

And a minimal JS example for quickstart:

```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ key: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'polaris-lite', input: 'Write a haiku' })
console.log(resp.output)
```

Mark both as "SDK v2" in the PR.

ci-bot: link-checker: found 1 broken link in docs/registry/nebulax-8k.md -> /embeddings/throughput.

sam: That link broke after reorganize; new target is /guides/embeddings/performance. Also suggest changing the field name across the catalog to "max_context_tokens" for consistency.

maya: Done in PR: renamed field, fixed link, added migration note mapping legacy `client.text_generate(...)` -> `client.generate_model(...)`. Also clarified bench table with explicit columns.

diego: For the compatibility matrix add a short note: "q4 variants: possible CPU fallback on older nodes; check runtime docs and your node capabilities." Link to /runtime/quantization#cpu-fallback included.

ci-bot: re-run requested by @maya  link-checker running...

ci-bot: link-checker: all links valid now.

maya: Thanks all. I'll merge once sam posts the tiny wording nit. Then I'll add a changelog entry under docs/releases for the catalog update. :rocket:

sam: Left a minor wording suggestion; otherwise LGTM.

maya: Merged and tagging product for release note. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
